publisher: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage

name: Gardiner Street Upper Post Box
publisher: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage

name: 10 Talbot Street
publisher: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage
notes: NIAH records a c.1840 terraced house with surviving Victorian upper-floor fabric, Flemish-bond brickwork, granite sills and decorative brick eaves course; coordinates 316154, 234766.

name: Dublin City Development Plan 2022–2028 — Policy BHA18
publisher: Dublin City Council
specific_reference: Section 11.5; Policy BHA18 — Historic Ground Surfaces, Street Furniture and Public Realm
notes: Council policy identifies historic ground surfaces and public-realm features including milestones, jostle stones, ward stones, bollards, coal-hole covers, gratings, boot scrapers, cast-iron basement lights, street skylights, water troughs, post boxes, lampposts and railings.

name: Architectural Inventory of Dublin North City
publisher: National Inventory of Architectural Heritage, Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage
specific_reference: Introduction and scope of the Dublin North City architectural inventory
notes: NIAH publication says over 2,800 structures were recorded in phases during 2011–2014 and explicitly notes that the inventory should not be regarded as exhaustive; it highlights overlooked domestic/commercial buildings, canal and railway structures, coal-hole covers, post boxes, railings and gates.
